_comment: Synthetic shared config example. Save as ~/.config/keyrotate/_mailjet.json and edit the downstream project/target list.

MAILJET_API_KEY._note: Public half of the shared Mailjet key pair. Rotate together with MAILJET_API_SECRET.
manualSteps: Open https://app.mailjet.com/account/apikeys and create a new API key pair.
After every downstream email path is verified, delete the old key pair in Mailjet.

MAILJET_API_SECRET._note: Private half of the shared Mailjet key pair. Some downstream projects may still receive it as MAILJET_SECRET_KEY via crossProjectPropagate[].key.

EMAIL_FROM._note: Verified sender address shared by Mailjet consumers. Use crossProjectPropagate[].key for projects that still read FROM_EMAIL, MAILJET_FROM_EMAIL, or ALERT_EMAIL_FROM.
